owner_decision.summary: enable a manual, read-only review of one existing PR only when the user explicitly types /pr-review-judge <PR>; disable-model-invocation stays true
not_approved: GitHub write by the reviewer (comment / edit / formal review / merge / push)
impl-review-loop auto start, Step 5 Final Gate, Bot / Broker / controlled pr_* route

change.kind: one inserted section (Manual Read-only Review (D13)) and two rewritten migration-note sentences; frontmatter unchanged
not_added: legacy full lint or Japanese-ratio validator

legacy_gate_policy: check_pr_review_gates.py needs the legacy g1 artifact, g2 findings block and g6 allowed_paths_gate block. Their absence is recorded as a warning (legacy_gate_input_missing); g4 head consistency and schema failure are blockers; M4 / M5 stay the canonical Allowed Paths / CI judges.

runtime_acceptance.rule: AC4 needs the user to type /pr-review-judge <D13 Draft PR number> in an interactive Claude Code session. Fixture results in this manifest are never a runtime PASS; reading the Skill file or an automatic invoke does not substitute.

count_evidence: Measured with pytest --co and a real run; the runner independently verifies per-file counts and JUnit outcome. Behavioural tests drive the real helper CLIs (validate_pr_body.py, allowed_paths_review_gate.py against an isolated Git repository, check_pr_review_gates.py, wait_ci_checks.py with patched gh reads); they verify no live GitHub behaviour.

historical_sync.rule: Only the current pr-review-judge SKILL.md hash / line count and the intentional_diff of the migration note were synchronized. source_blob_sha1 / source_sha256 and the D5-time and D8-time records are kept as historical_pre_d8 / historical_pre_d13. The D6 and D11 manifests are unchanged (their evidence_boundary records the state at their own time).

rollback: Revert the single D13 PR: it removes the manual section, this manifest, the D13 test and CI lane, and restores the D5 / D8 current hashes. D11 open-pr, the D5 / D6 source pins and the hook-free policy are not modified.
ci_binding: The i4-4d13 job runs this manifest through scripts/ci/run_stage1b1_tests.py and the full tests/stage_i4 directory; no new permissions, runner or secrets.
